'''Kerm''' was an individual who was on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]].<ref name="Chapter 22" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kerm first appeared in "[[Chapter 22: Guns for Hire]]," the twenty-second episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]]. [[John Cameron]] is credited as being the performance artist for Kerm.<ref name="Chapter 22" />
